summary: Completed independent verification of Checkpoint 2 - Tire Match Wizard Steps 1 and 2. Tested backend APIs, frontend functionality at mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800) viewports, URL parameter handling, localStorage behavior, attribution tracking, network request monitoring, and regression tests. All critical requirements verified successfully.
